tasks.label: Prepare SIGAPTEL Dart Define
args: if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/env/local.json') { Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}/env/local.json' '${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/.dart-define.generated.json' -Force; Write-Host 'Using env/local.json for dart-define.' } else { '{}' | Set-Content -Path '${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/.dart-define.generated.json' -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host 'env/local.json not found. Using empty dart-define file (debug fallback active).'; }
